data.content_ref: inline:For question-2f9eac6de35390886b837a79ed2d9548, SRC_002 answers 'ambiguous' and invokes time-trial semantics as a countercondition. But the problem explicitly states 'you overtake the runner in second place,' an operation only defined under positional racing semantics (where 'second place' denotes an ordinal position in a shared ordering). Time-trial semantics have no 'second place' runner to overtake, so the cited ambiguity is speculative and not supported by the problem text; the target thereby fails the problem as stated by refusing the single-word/number answer the problem demands.
